用 AI 寫繁體中文長篇連載小說的本機工作台。小說資料（設定、大綱、追蹤、正文）: A local workbench for writing long serialized novels with AI. All novel data (settings, outline, tracking, text) is plain Markdown + YAML, stored in your own library folder; the web interface handles project management, and the writing flow can be handed to Claude Code, or to OpenAI-compatible models such as DeepSeek and llama.cpp.
